evidence_markers: S100A12; S100A8; S100A9; CD14; FCN1; RETN; VCAN; LYZ; MNDA; CSF3R; CXCL8; MAFB; SPI1; CEBPD
rationale: The marker list is dominated by classical monocyte genes: S100A12, S100A8, S100A9, CD14, S100A11, and FCN1 are highly specific for CD14+ classical monocytes. These cells also express RETN, VCAN, LYZ, MNDA, and CSTA, which are typical for this subset. The presence of CSF3R, CXCL8, and PLAUR supports an inflammatory state. Enrichment terms are mostly broad (metabolism, genetic information processing) but not cell-type specific, so they do not override the strong monocyte marker evidence. The absence of T-cell (CD3D, CD8A) or NK-cell (FCGR3A, FGFBP2) markers rules out those lineages. The inclusion of MAFB, CEBPD, and SPI1 indicates a myelomonocytic transcriptional program.
